name: Beef "Cheeseburger" Quesadillas with Pickles & Special Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add beef, salt, and pepper; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 lb lean ground beef
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, finely chop half of the pickles and place in a small bowl. Add mayo, ketchup, and vinegar, then stir to combine the special sauce; set aside. (Reserve remaining pickles for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup dill pickle chips
½ cup mayonnaise
2 tbsp ketchup
1 tsp white vinegar

instructions.primary_message: When the beef is done, remove from heat. Add ketchup, mustard, and Worcestershire to the skillet, then stir to combine the filling.
instructions.secondary_message:
ketchup
1 tsp yellow mustard
½ tsp Worcestershire sauce

instructions.primary_message: To assemble the quesadillas, lay tortillas on a flat surface and divide filling between them, arranging on one half of each tortilla. Top with remaining pickles and shredded cheese, then fold in half to close.

Wipe the skillet clean with paper towels and return to medium-high heat; add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, place assembled quesadillas in the skillet and cook, flipping halfway through, until tortillas are golden on both sides, 5-6 minutes. Remove to a plate.
Cut each quesadilla into wedges and divide between plates. Serve with special sauce for dipping and enjoy!
